definitions.gloss: airtight container; sealed container; hermetically sealed vessel
definitions.explanation: a container designed to be completely sealed to prevent air, moisture, or other substances from getting in or out

examples.japanese: ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{密閉容器|みっぺいようき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Store food in an airtight container.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{密閉容器|みっぺいようき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}して→移す：10122_utsusu⟧⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I transferred the leftover soup to an airtight container and put it in the fridge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{湿気|しっけ}→湿気：03177_shikke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{密閉容器|みっぺいようき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}しない→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧しまう。
examples.english: Medicines that are sensitive to moisture will lose quality if not stored in a sealed container.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{密閉|みっぺい}→密閉：19651_mippei⟧ (hermetic sealing; airtight closure) + ⟦{容器|ようき}→容器：03656_youki⟧ (container; vessel). Used in both everyday contexts (food storage) and technical/industrial contexts (chemical storage, laboratory equipment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {密閉容器|みっぺいようき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in an airtight container
- {密閉容器|みっぺいようき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to store in a sealed container
- {密閉容器|みっぺいようき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}する→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧: to keep in a sealed container
- ⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧{密閉容器|みっぺいようき}: glass airtight container

SIMILAR WORDS:
- タッパー: Tupperware — a colloquial term for plastic food storage containers (often airtight)
- ⟦{保存容器|ほぞんようき}→保存容器：21184_hozonyouki⟧: storage container — broader term that may or may not be airtight
- ⟦{密封|みっぷう}→密封：18258_mippuu⟧⟦パック→パック：11002_pakku⟧: vacuum-sealed pack — emphasizes vacuum sealing rather than just air-tightness
